title: Base rate for management promise delivery in Indian auto components (UNIPARTS, SONACOMS, SANSERA, HAPPYFORGE, ENDURANCE; Nov 2026)
body: Same-method promise scores for five Indian auto-component makers (last 6 concalls each, Aug-2025 to Nov-2026; UNIPARTS from its 10-call pilot). Weighted delivery (credit, specificity-weighted): SONACOMS 83.3% (n=6), SANSERA 60.0% (n=8), HAPPYFORGE 50.0% (n=7), ENDURANCE 26.1% (n=9), UNIPARTS 64.8% (n=47). Sector pattern: group revenue and margin guidance is usually met (pooled revenue 68.8%, margin 80.6%); capacity/SOP dates are the weak category (pooled 43.3%), with 1-5 quarter slips at Endurance, Happy Forgings and Sansera - the same date-slip pattern seen in T&D (L18). Two of five (Sona, Endurance) refuse revenue guidance, so their scored records are mostly mix statements or SOP dates; categories rarely reach n>=5, so SAC is computed with small categories pooled. SAC (pts vs leave-one-out peer medians): SONACOMS +50.0, SANSERA -4.8, HAPPYFORGE +3.6, ENDURANCE -43.0, UNIPARTS -8.1. Use: base rates by category for credibility-generated paper calls (thesis tag credibility-generated). n is small (6-9 scored per new company): provisional. Research, not advice.

data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 4 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
